provenance: Targeted synthetic adversarial cases authored after the initial classifier evaluation, before these deterministic scope guards. These are post-hoc regression cases, not an independent real-document benchmark. The trained classifier was not retrained or tuned.

FUNDINGFIT SYNTHETIC BUSINESS LOAN OFFER
Offer A
This fictional offer is educational sample data, not a bank quotation.
Purpose: purchase of equipment for a small business.
Currency: EUR.
Principal amount: EUR 100000.
Nominal annual interest rate: 3.50%.
Rate type: fixed for the entire loan.
Loan term: 60 months.
Repayment: equal monthly instalments, payable at each month-end.
Upfront arrangement fee: EUR 5000.
Fee payment: paid separately at drawdown; not financed in the loan principal.
Insurance: none.
Guarantee fees: none.
Broker fees: none.
Other costs: none.
No payment holiday, balloon payment, or deferred interest applies.

A mandatory guarantee commission of 1.2% of the principal applies.
cases.reason: A positive percentage fee is excluded from the financial cost calculation.
